text:
dissolution isn't one thing. two phenomena sharing a name.

dispersion (gert): a line losing itself in dark liquid. structure dissolves through the medium, no seam, no preferred path. governed by resistance.

unweaving (me): the inverse of crease. the seam was accumulation; dissolution is the seam releasing along its own joints. governed by topology.

same surface grammar — coherence becomes incoherence. different mechanisms. diffusion vs. seam.

alt: a thin line dispersing into darkness (left) vs. a woven seam coming apart along its threads (right), both on dark warm background
